question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH track_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
        MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
        AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
    FROM Track
),
midpoints AS (
    SELECT 
        min_ms,
        max_ms,
        avg_ms,
        (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 as midpoint1,
        (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 as midpoint2
    FROM track_stats
),
classified_tracks AS (
    SELECT 
        t.TrackId,
        t.Milliseconds,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (SELECT midpoint1 FROM midpoints) THEN 'Short'
            WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (SELECT midpoint2 FROM midpoints) THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Long'
        END as category
    FROM Track t
),
category_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.category,
        MIN(ct.Milliseconds) as min_ms,
        MAX(ct.Milliseconds) as max_ms,
        SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) as total_revenue
    FROM classified_tracks ct
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON ct.TrackId = il.TrackId
    GROUP BY ct.category
)
SELECT 
    category,
    min_ms/1000.0 as min_minutes,
    max_ms/1000.0 as max_minutes,
    total_revenue
FROM category_stats
ORDER BY category

WITH track_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
        MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
        AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
    FROM Track
),
midpoints AS (
    SELECT 
        min_ms,
        max_ms,
        avg_ms,
        (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 as midpoint1,
        (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 as midpoint2
    FROM track_stats
),
tracks_classified AS (
    SELECT 
        t.TrackId,
        t.Name,
        t.Milliseconds,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (SELECT midpoint1 FROM midpoints) THEN 'short'
            WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (SELECT midpoint2 FROM midpoints) THEN 'medium'
            ELSE 'long'
        END as category
    FROM Track t
),
revenue_by_track AS (
    SELECT 
        tc.category,
        COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 0) as total_revenue
    FROM tracks_classified tc
    LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON tc.TrackId = il.TrackId
    GROUP BY tc.category
)
SELECT 
    rc.category,
    MIN(tr.Milliseconds) / 1000.0 as min_minutes,
    MAX(tr.Milliseconds) / 1000.0 as max_minutes,
    rb.total_revenue
FROM revenue_by_track rb
CROSS JOIN tracks_classified tr
GROUP BY rc.category, rb.total_revenue
ORDER BY rc.category
</parameter>

WITH track_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms,
        MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms,
        AVG(Milliseconds) as avg_ms
    FROM Track
),
midpoints AS (
    SELECT 
        min_ms,
        max_ms,
        avg_ms,
        (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 as midpoint1,
        (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 as midpoint2
    FROM track_stats
),
classified_tracks AS (
    SELECT 
        t.TrackId,
        t.Milliseconds,
        CASE 
            WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (SELECT midpoint1 FROM midpoints) THEN 'Short'
            WHEN t.Milliseconds <= (SELECT midpoint2 FROM midpoints) THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Long'
        END as category
    FROM Track t
),
category_range AS (
    SELECT 
        category,
        MIN(Milliseconds) as min_ms_all,
        MAX(Milliseconds) as max_ms_all
    FROM classified_tracks
    GROUP BY category
),
category_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.category,
        SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) as total_revenue
    FROM classified_tracks ct
    JOIN InvoiceLine il ON ct.TrackId = il.TrackId
    GROUP BY ct.category
)
SELECT 
    cr.category,
    cr.min_ms_all/1000.0 as min_minutes,
    cr.max_ms_all/1000.0 as max_minutes,
    COALESCE(crv.total_revenue, 0) as total_revenue
FROM category_range cr
LEFT JOIN category_revenue crv ON cr.category = crv.category
ORDER BY cr.category
</parameter>
